stories.title: Relevance Measure Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define Pydantic schema for trial relevance scoring including fields for condition_match_score, eligibility_match_score, overall_relevance_score, and supporting metadata. Ensure compatibility with existing clinical_trials_models input/output contracts.

stories.title: Condition Matching Logic
stories.description: Implement logic to compare user query condition (normalized text or ICD context if available) against trial condition fields from ClinicalTrials.gov results. Produce a normalized condition_match_score based on exact, partial, and semantic matches.

stories.title: Eligibility Criteria Parsing and Matching
stories.description: Extract and parse eligibility criteria from trial data and evaluate alignment with inferred user attributes (age, gender, condition context). Generate eligibility_match_score with rule-based parsing and fallback heuristics.

stories.title: Relevance Score Aggregation
stories.description: Combine condition and eligibility scores into a single overall_relevance_score with deterministic weighting. Produce a structured relevance payload ready for downstream consumption without coupling to presentation logic.

stories.title: Relevance Scoring Tests and Integration Validation
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating condition matching, eligibility parsing, aggregation, and facade exposure. Ensure no regression in clinical trial search flows and correct propagation through EvaluateCare facade.
